name: Agriculture Decision Support Portal
description: A national-scale agri-data portal: full-screen aerial hero, modules with sub-pages, map dashboard, collaborators, data catalog, data exchange, login and policy pages.

slides.heading: Geospatial data, information and customised solutions for informed decision making in agriculture
Gateway to a repository of data layers with advanced analytics for agriculture
Discovering the power of data and analytics to modernise decision making in agriculture

data.heading: Unlocking the power of data for enhancing the performance of agriculture
data.text: A geospatial platform hosting a wide range of agricultural datasets, with analytics and deep insights for every stakeholder. It supports evidence-based decisions and the efficient implementation of agricultural programmes and schemes — aligning agriculture with climate-resilient and sustainable development goals.
bullets: Satellite, weather, soil and crop data in one place
Analytics from national down to field-parcel level
Open standards and APIs for partners

data.heading: Supporting multiple stakeholders — from farmers to policy makers
data.text: A single window for multiple datasets and thematic information products, minimising the effort of collecting and processing data. Registered users get exclusive services such as closed-group interactions, blogs, news and surveys.

data.heading: Bringing new forms of data, information and knowledge to agriculture
data.text: Spatial and non-spatial datasets are fetched from many sources, standardised and integrated, so every user group gets customised data and information services without duplicated effort.
